```rust
 671 | fn print_summary(result: &GlobalResult) {
 672 |     println!("\n{}", "━".repeat(78));
 673 |     println!("  OVERALL SUMMARY  ({} documents analyzed)", format_num(result.num_docs));
 674 |     println!("{}", "━".repeat(78));
 675 | 
 676 |     println!(
 677 |         "\n  {:<30} {:>8} {:>8} {:>8} {:>12}",
 678 |         "Category", "Proposed", "Found", "Coverage", "Total Hits"
 679 |     );
 680 |     println!(
 681 |         "  {} {} {} {} {}",
 682 |         "─".repeat(30),
 683 |         "─".repeat(8),
 684 |         "─".repeat(8),
 685 |         "─".repeat(8),
 686 |         "─".repeat(12),
 687 |     );
 688 | 
 689 |     let mut grand_proposed = 0u64;
 690 |     let mut grand_found = 0u64;
 691 |     let mut grand_hits = 0u64;
 692 | 
 693 |     for cat in CATEGORIES {
 694 |         let total = cat.tokens.len();
 695 |         let mut found = 0;
 696 |         let mut hits = 0u64;
 697 |         for &token in cat.tokens {
 698 |             let count = match cat.mode {
 699 |                 MatchMode::Ident => *result.ident_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 700 |                 MatchMode::Dollar => *result.dollar_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 701 |                 MatchMode::SqlString => *result.sql_keyword_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 702 |             };
 703 |             if count > 0 {
 704 |                 found += 1;
 705 |             }
 706 |             hits += count;
 707 |         }
 708 | 
 709 |         let coverage = if total > 0 {
 710 |             found as f64 / total as f64 * 100.0
 711 |         } else {
 712 |             0.0
 713 |         };
 714 | 
 715 |         grand_proposed += total as u64;
 716 |         grand_found += found as u64;
 717 |         grand_hits += hits;
 718 | 
 719 |         println!(
 720 |             "  {:<30} {:>8} {:>8} {:>7.0}% {:>12}",
 721 |             cat.name, total, found, coverage, format_num(hits),
 722 |         );
 723 |     }
 724 | 
 725 |     println!(
 726 |         "  {} {} {} {} {}",
 727 |         "─".repeat(30),
 728 |         "─".repeat(8),
 729 |         "─".repeat(8),
 730 |         "─".repeat(8),
 731 |         "─".repeat(12),
 732 |     );
 733 |     let grand_coverage = if grand_proposed > 0 {
 734 |         grand_found as f64 / grand_proposed as f64 * 100.0
 735 |     } else {
 736 |         0.0
 737 |     };
 738 |     println!(
 739 |         "  {:<30} {:>8} {:>8} {:>7.0}% {:>12}",
 740 |         "TOTAL",
 741 |         grand_proposed,
 742 |         grand_found,
 743 |         grand_coverage,
 744 |         format_num(grand_hits),
 745 |     );
 746 | }

 799 | fn write_json(result: &GlobalResult, elapsed: f64, path: &str) {
 800 |     let mut vocab: HashMap<String, Vec<JsonToken>> = HashMap::new();
 801 | 
 802 |     for cat in CATEGORIES {
 803 |         let mut tokens: Vec<JsonToken> = cat
 804 |             .tokens
 805 |             .iter()
 806 |             .map(|&token| {
 807 |                 let (count, doc_count) = match cat.mode {
 808 |                     MatchMode::Ident => (
 809 |                         *result.ident_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 810 |                         *result.doc_presence.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 811 |                     ),
 812 |                     MatchMode::Dollar => (
 813 |                         *result.dollar_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 814 |                         *result.dollar_doc_presence.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 815 |                     ),
 816 |                     MatchMode::SqlString => (
 817 |                         *result.sql_keyword_counts.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),
 818 |                         *result.sql_doc_presence.get(token).unwrap_or(&0),

 821 |                 let doc_pct = if result.num_docs > 0 {

 823 |                 } else {
 824 |                     0.0

 826 |                 JsonToken {

 830 |                     doc_pct,

 834 |             .collect();

 839 |     let mut morphemes_json: HashMap<String, Vec<JsonStem>> = HashMap::new();

 842 |             .stems
 843 |             .iter()
 844 |             .map(|&s| JsonStem {
 845 |                 stem: s.to_owned(),

 847 |             })

 849 |         stems.sort_by(|a, b| b.count.cmp(&a.count));
 850 |         morphemes_json.insert(cat.name.to_owned(), stems);

 854 |         .namespace_counts
 855 |         .iter()
 856 |         .map(|(k, v)| JsonNamespace {
 857 |             name: k.clone(),
 858 |             count: *v,
 859 |         })
 860 |         .collect();
 861 |     ns.sort_by(|a, b| b.count.cmp(&a.count));
 862 |     ns.truncate(100);
 863 |

 865 |         .iter()
 866 |         .map(|&kw| JsonKeyword {
 867 |             keyword: kw.to_owned(),
 868 |             count: *result.ident_counts.get(kw).unwrap_or(&0),
 869 |         })
 870 |         .collect();
 871 |     kws.sort_by(|a, b| b.count.cmp(&a.count));
 872 |     kws.dedup_by(|a, b| a.keyword == b.keyword);
 873 | 
 874 |     let mean_len = if result.total_idents > 0 {
 875 |         result.total_ident_len as f64 / result.total_idents as f64
 876 |     } else {
 877 |         0.0
 878 |     };
 879 | 
 880 |     let output = JsonOutput {
 881 |         num_docs: result.num_docs,
 882 |         total_idents: result.total_idents,
 883 |         mean_ident_len: mean_len,
 884 |         elapsed_s: elapsed,
 885 |         vocab,
 886 |         morphemes: morphemes_json,
 887 |         style: JsonStyle {
 888 |             snake_case: result.style_counts.snake_case,
 889 |             camel_case: result.style_counts.camel_case,
 890 |             pascal_case: result.style_counts.pascal_case,
 891 |             screaming_case: result.style_counts.screaming_case,
 892 |             mixed_other: result.style_counts.mixed_other,
 893 |         },
 894 |         top_namespaces: ns,

 898 |     let file = fs::File::create(path).expect("Failed to create output file");
 899 |     let writer = BufWriter::with_capacity(64 * 1024 * 1024, file);

 904 | // ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 905 | 
 906 | fn main() {
 907 |     let args = Args::parse();
 908 | 
 909 |     // Configure rayon thread pool
 910 |     if args.threads > 0 {
 911 |         rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::new()
 912 |             .num_threads(args.threads)
 913 |             .build_global()
 914 |             .expect("Failed to set thread count");
 915 |     }
 916 |     let num_threads = rayon::current_num_threads();
 917 | 
 918 |     let do_morphemes = args.morphemes || args.all;
 919 |     let do_keywords = args.keywords || args.all;
 920 |     let do_namespaces = args.namespaces || args.all;
 921 |     let do_styles = args.styles || args.all;
 922 |     let do_content = args.content || args.all;
 923 | 
 924 |     // Collect files
 925 |     eprintln!("Collecting files from {} input path(s)...", args.inputs.len());
 926 |     let t_collect = Instant::now();
 927 |     let mut files = collect_files(&args.inputs, &args.extensions);
 928 |     if let Some(max) = args.max_files {
 929 |         files.truncate(max);
 930 |     }
 931 |     eprintln!(
 932 |         "Found {} files in {:.1}s",
 933 |         format_num(files.len() as u64),
 934 |         t_collect.elapsed().as_secs_f64(),
 935 |     );
 936 | 
 937 |     if files.is_empty() {
 938 |         eprintln!("Error: No files found");
 939 |         std::process::exit(1);
 940 |     }
 941 | 
 942 |     // Calculate total size
 943 |     let total_bytes: u64 = files.iter().filter_map(|f| fs::metadata(f).ok()).map(|m| m.len()).sum();
 944 |     eprintln!(
 945 |         "Total size: {:.2} GB, using {} threads",
 946 |         total_bytes as f64 / 1e9,
 947 |         num_threads,
 948 |     );
 949 | 
 950 |     // Process files in parallel using rayon
 951 |     let t0 = Instant::now();
 952 |     let files_done = AtomicU64::new(0);
 953 |     let bytes_done = AtomicU64::new(0);
 954 |     let total_files = files.len() as u64;
 955 | 
 956 |     // Process in parallel batches to reduce merge overhead
 957 |     let batch_size = std::cmp::max(100, files.len() / (num_threads * 4));
 958 |     let batches: Vec<&[PathBuf]> = files.chunks(batch_size).collect();
 959 | 
 960 |     eprintln!("Processing {} batches of ~{} files...", batches.len(), batch_size);
 961 | 
 962 |     let batch_results: Vec<GlobalResult> = batches
 963 |         .par_iter()
 964 |         .map(|batch| {
 965 |             let mut local = GlobalResult::new();
 966 |             for path in *batch {
 967 |                 let docs = read_file_contents(path);
 968 |                 let file_size = fs::metadata(path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
 969 | 
 970 |                 for doc_bytes in &docs {
 971 |                     let doc_result = analyze_document(doc_bytes, do_morphemes, do_content);
 972 |                     local.merge_doc(doc_result);
 973 |                 }
 974 | 
 975 |                 let done = files_done.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;
 976 |                 bytes_done.fetch_add(file_size, Ordering::Relaxed);
 977 | 
 978 |                 // Progress every 10K files
 979 |                 if done % 10_000 == 0 || done == total_files {
 980 |                     let elapsed = t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
 981 |                     let gb_done = bytes_done.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as f64 / 1e9;
 982 |                     let rate = done as f64 / elapsed;
 983 |                     eprintln!(
 984 |                         "  [{}/{}] {:.1} GB, {:.0} files/sec, {:.1}s",
 985 |                         format_num(done),
 986 |                         format_num(total_files),
 987 |                         gb_done,
 988 |                         rate,
 989 |                         elapsed,
 990 |                     );
 991 |                 }
 992 |             }
 993 |             local
 994 |         })
 995 |         .collect();
 996 | 
 997 |     // Merge all batch results
 998 |     eprintln!("Merging {} batch results...", batch_results.len());
 999 |     let mut result = GlobalResult::new();
1000 |     for batch in batch_results {
1001 |         merge_globals(&mut result, batch);
1002 |     }
1003 | 
1004 |     if do_keywords {
1005 |         result.compute_keyword_counts();
1006 |     }
1007 | 
1008 |     let elapsed = t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
1009 |     let throughput_gb = total_bytes as f64 / 1e9 / elapsed;
1010 |     eprintln!(
1011 |         "\nCompleted: {} docs from {} files in {:.1}s ({:.1} GB/s, {:.0} files/sec)",
1012 |         format_num(result.num_docs),
1013 |         format_num(total_files),
1014 |         elapsed,
1015 |         throughput_gb,
1016 |         total_files as f64 / elapsed,
1017 |     );
1018 | 
1019 |     // Write JSON output if requested
1020 |     if let Some(ref output_path) = args.output {
1021 |         write_json(&result, elapsed, output_path);
1022 |     }
1023 | 
1024 |     // Print reports
1025 |     let cat_filter = args.category.as_deref().map(|c| c.to_lowercase());
1026 | 
1027 |     for cat in CATEGORIES {
1028 |         if let Some(ref filter) = cat_filter {
1029 |             if !cat.name.to_lowercase().contains(filter.as_str()) {
1030 |                 continue;
1031 |             }
1032 |         }
1033 |         print_category_report(cat.name, cat.tokens, cat.mode, &result, args.top);
1034 |     }
1035 | 
1036 |     if do_morphemes {
1037 |         print_morpheme_report(&result, args.top);
1038 |     }
1039 | 
1040 |     if do_keywords {
1041 |         print_keyword_report(&result, args.top);
1042 |     }
1043 | 
1044 |     if do_namespaces {
1045 |         print_namespace_report(&result, args.top);
1046 |     }
1047 | 
1048 |     if do_styles {
1049 |         print_style_report(&result);
1050 |     }
1051 | 
1052 |     if do_content {
1053 |         print_content_report(&result);
1054 |     }
1055 | 
1056 |     // Always print summary
1057 |     print_summary(&result);
1058 | 
1059 |     // Flush stdout
1060 |     let _ = io::stdout().lock().flush();
1061 | }
```

```rust
 1 | use std::sync::OnceLock;
 2 | use tokenizers::Tokenizer;
 3 | 
 4 | static TOKENIZER: OnceLock<Option<Tokenizer>> = OnceLock::new();
 5 | 
 6 | pub fn get_token_count(text: &str) -> usize {
 7 |     let tok = TOKENIZER.get_or_init(|| Tokenizer::from_pretrained("gpt2", None).ok());
 8 | 
 9 |     if let Some(tokenizer) = tok {
10 |         if let Ok(encoded) = tokenizer.encode(text, false) {
11 |             return encoded.get_ids().len();
12 |         }
13 |     }
14 |     // Fallback heuristic
15 |     std::cmp::max(1, text.len() / 4)
16 | }
```

```python
  1 | """Cppmega tokenizer wrapper with M0.1 contract checks.
  2 | 
  3 | The loader intentionally refuses artifacts that do not exactly match the
  4 | documented M0.1 tokenizer contract.  This avoids silently training against a
  5 | nearby nanochat tokenizer with different reserved IDs.
  6 | """
  7 | 
  8 | from __future__ import annotations
  9 | 
 10 | import json
 11 | import re
 12 | from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
 13 | from pathlib import Path
 14 | from typing import Any
 15 | 
 16 | EXPECTED_VOCAB_SIZE = 65_536
 17 | EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS: dict[str, int] = {
 18 |     "<BOS>": 2,
 19 |     "<EOS>": 3,
 20 |     "<FIM_PREFIX>": 4,
 21 |     "<FIM_MIDDLE>": 5,
 22 |     "<FIM_SUFFIX>": 6,
 23 |     "<CODE_START>": 7,
 24 |     "<CODE_END>": 8,
 25 |     "<THINK_START>": 9,
 26 |     "<THINK_END>": 10,
 27 |     "<QUERY_TOOL>": 11,
 28 |     "<TOOL_RESULT>": 19,
 29 |     "<FIM_INSTRUCTION>": 45,
 30 |     "<SPACE>": 46,
 31 |     "<NL>": 47,
 32 | }
 33 | 
 34 | 
 35 | # Whitespace normalization: collapse runs to a single sentinel token so that
 36 | # BPE-split identifiers (e.g., "sum" -> "s","u","m") decode without spurious
 37 | # inter-token spaces. Encode normalizes; decode replaces sentinels back.
 38 | _WS_RUN_RE = re.compile(r"[ \t]+")
 39 | _NL_RUN_RE = re.compile(r"[\r\n]+")
 40 | 
 41 | 
 42 | class TokenizerContractError(ValueError):
 43 |     """Raised when a tokenizer artifact does not satisfy M0.1."""
 44 | 
 45 | 
 46 | class CppMegaTokenizer:
 47 |     """Thin wrapper around ``tokenizers.Tokenizer`` with stable cppmega APIs."""
 48 | 
 49 |     def __init__(self, tokenizer: Any, *, path: Path):
 50 |         self._tokenizer = tokenizer
 51 |         self.path = path
 52 |         self._vocab: dict[str, int] = dict(tokenizer.get_vocab())
 53 |         self._id_to_token = {token_id: token for token, token_id in self._vocab.items()}
 54 |         self._space_token_id = EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<SPACE>"]
 55 |         self._nl_token_id = EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<NL>"]
 56 | 
 57 |     @property
 58 |     def vocab_size(self) -> int:
 59 |         return int(self._tokenizer.get_vocab_size(with_added_tokens=True))
 60 | 
 61 |     @property
 62 |     def bos_token_id(self) -> int:
 63 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<BOS>"]
 64 | 
 65 |     @property
 66 |     def eos_token_id(self) -> int:
 67 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<EOS>"]
 68 | 
 69 |     @property
 70 |     def fim_prefix_id(self) -> int:
 71 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<FIM_PREFIX>"]
 72 | 
 73 |     @property
 74 |     def fim_middle_id(self) -> int:
 75 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<FIM_MIDDLE>"]
 76 | 
 77 |     @property
 78 |     def fim_suffix_id(self) -> int:
 79 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<FIM_SUFFIX>"]
 80 | 
 81 |     @property
 82 |     def code_start_id(self) -> int:
 83 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<CODE_START>"]
 84 | 
 85 |     @property
 86 |     def code_end_id(self) -> int:
 87 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<CODE_END>"]
 88 | 
 89 |     @property
 90 |     def think_start_id(self) -> int:
 91 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<THINK_START>"]
 92 | 
 93 |     @property
 94 |     def think_end_id(self) -> int:
 95 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<THINK_END>"]
 96 | 
 97 |     @property
 98 |     def query_tool_id(self) -> int:
 99 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<QUERY_TOOL>"]
100 | 
101 |     @property
102 |     def tool_result_id(self) -> int:
103 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<TOOL_RESULT>"]
104 | 
105 |     @property
106 |     def fim_instruction_id(self) -> int:
107 |         return EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS["<FIM_INSTRUCTION>"]
108 | 
109 |     @property
110 |     def space_token_id(self) -> int:
111 |         return self._space_token_id
112 | 
113 |     @property
114 |     def nl_token_id(self) -> int:
115 |         return self._nl_token_id
116 | 
117 |     def get_vocab_size(self) -> int:
118 |         return self.vocab_size
119 | 
120 |     @staticmethod
121 |     def _normalize_whitespace(text: str) -> str:
122 |         """Collapse whitespace runs to ``<SPACE>``/``<NL>`` sentinel tokens."""
123 |         text = _NL_RUN_RE.sub("<NL>", text)
124 |         text = _WS_RUN_RE.sub("<SPACE>", text)
125 |         return text
126 | 
127 |     def encode(
128 |         self,
129 |         text: str | Sequence[str],
130 |         *,
131 |         prepend: int | str | None = None,
132 |         append: int | str | None = None,
133 |     ) -> list[int] | list[list[int]]:
134 |         prepend_id = self._resolve_optional_token(prepend)
135 |         append_id = self._resolve_optional_token(append)
136 | 
137 |         if isinstance(text, str):
138 |             normalized = self._normalize_whitespace(text)
139 |             ids = list(self._tokenizer.encode(normalized).ids)
140 |             return self._with_optional_tokens(ids, prepend_id, append_id)
141 |         if isinstance(text, Sequence):
142 |             normalized_batch = [self._normalize_whitespace(t) for t in text]
143 |             rows = [
144 |                 list(encoded.ids)
145 |                 for encoded in self._tokenizer.encode_batch(normalized_batch)
146 |             ]
147 |             return [
148 |                 self._with_optional_tokens(row, prepend_id, append_id) for row in rows
149 |             ]
150 |         raise TypeError(f"text must be str or sequence[str], got {type(text).__name__}")
151 | 
152 |     def encode_batch(self, texts: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[int]]:
153 |         normalized = [self._normalize_whitespace(t) for t in texts]
154 |         return [list(encoded.ids) for encoded in self._tokenizer.encode_batch(normalized)]
155 | 
156 |     def decode(self, ids: Iterable[int]) -> str:
157 |         """Decode IDs by simple concat then replacing ``<SPACE>``/``<NL>`` sentinels.
158 | 
159 |         The encoder substitutes whitespace runs with ``<SPACE>``/``<NL>`` tokens so
160 |         that BPE-split identifiers decode without spurious inter-token spaces.
161 |         Byte-exact for any input whose internal whitespace runs are at most a
162 |         single space or single newline (longer runs are collapsed by the
163 |         normalizer). Matches the CUDA-side ``nanochat.cpp_tokenizer`` decode.
164 |         """
165 |         parts = [self._id_to_token.get(int(i), "") for i in ids]
166 |         s = "".join(parts)
167 |         return s.replace("<SPACE>", " ").replace("<NL>", "\n")
168 | 
169 |     def token_for_id(self, token_id: int) -> str | None:
170 |         return self._id_to_token.get(token_id)
171 | 
172 |     def id_for_token(self, token: str) -> int | None:
173 |         return self._vocab.get(token)
174 | 
175 |     def __call__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
176 |         return self.encode(*args, **kwargs)
177 | 
178 |     def _resolve_optional_token(self, token: int | str | None) -> int | None:
179 |         if token is None:
180 |             return None
181 |         if isinstance(token, int) and not isinstance(token, bool):
182 |             return token
183 |         if isinstance(token, str):
184 |             token_id = self.id_for_token(token)
185 |             if token_id is None:
186 |                 raise TokenizerContractError(f"unknown special token {token!r}")
187 |             return token_id
188 |         raise TypeError(f"token must be int or str, got {type(token).__name__}")
189 | 
190 |     @staticmethod
191 |     def _with_optional_tokens(
192 |         ids: list[int], prepend_id: int | None, append_id: int | None
193 |     ) -> list[int]:
194 |         if prepend_id is not None:
195 |             ids.insert(0, prepend_id)
196 |         if append_id is not None:
197 |             ids.append(append_id)
198 |         return ids
199 | 
200 | 
201 | def load_cppmega_tokenizer(path: str | Path) -> CppMegaTokenizer:
202 |     """Load a tokenizer only if it satisfies the M0.1 contract."""
203 | 
204 |     tokenizer_path = _resolve_tokenizer_path(path)
205 |     payload = _load_tokenizer_json(tokenizer_path)
206 |     vocab = _extract_vocab(payload, tokenizer_path)
207 |     _validate_vocab_contract(vocab, tokenizer_path)
208 | 
209 |     try:
210 |         from tokenizers import Tokenizer  # pyright: ignore[reportMissingImports]
211 |     except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
212 |         raise TokenizerContractError(
213 |             "tokenizers package is required to load cppmega tokenizer artifacts"
214 |         ) from exc
215 | 
216 |     return CppMegaTokenizer(Tokenizer.from_file(str(tokenizer_path)), path=tokenizer_path)
217 | 
218 | 
219 | def _resolve_tokenizer_path(path: str | Path) -> Path:
220 |     candidate = Path(path)
221 |     if candidate.is_dir():
222 |         candidate = candidate / "tokenizer.json"
223 |     if not candidate.is_file():
224 |         raise FileNotFoundError(f"tokenizer artifact not found: {candidate}")
225 |     return candidate
226 | 
227 | 
228 | def _load_tokenizer_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
229 |     try:
230 |         payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
231 |     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
232 |         raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: invalid tokenizer JSON") from exc
233 |     if not isinstance(payload, dict):
234 |         raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: tokenizer JSON must be an object")
235 |     return payload
236 | 
237 | 
238 | def _extract_vocab(payload: dict[str, Any], path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
239 |     model = payload.get("model")
240 |     if not isinstance(model, dict):
241 |         raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: missing tokenizer model")
242 |     raw_vocab = model.get("vocab")
243 |     if not isinstance(raw_vocab, dict):
244 |         raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: missing tokenizer model vocab")
245 | 
246 |     vocab: dict[str, int] = {}
247 |     seen_ids: set[int] = set()
248 |     for token, token_id in raw_vocab.items():
249 |         if not isinstance(token, str) or not isinstance(token_id, int):
250 |             raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: vocab entries must be str->int")
251 |         if token_id in seen_ids:
252 |             raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: duplicate vocab id {token_id}")
253 |         seen_ids.add(token_id)
254 |         vocab[token] = token_id
255 |     return vocab
256 | 
257 | 
258 | def _validate_vocab_contract(vocab: dict[str, int], path: Path) -> None:
259 |     if len(vocab) != EXPECTED_VOCAB_SIZE:
260 |         raise TokenizerContractError(
261 |             f"{path}: expected vocab size {EXPECTED_VOCAB_SIZE}, got {len(vocab)}"
262 |         )
263 | 
264 |     id_to_token = {token_id: token for token, token_id in vocab.items()}
265 |     if len(id_to_token) != len(vocab):
266 |         raise TokenizerContractError(f"{path}: vocab ids must be unique")
267 | 
268 |     for token, expected_id in EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS.items():
269 |         actual_id = vocab.get(token)
270 |         if actual_id != expected_id:
271 |             occupant = id_to_token.get(expected_id)
272 |             raise TokenizerContractError(
273 |                 f"{path}: token {token!r} must use id {expected_id}, "
274 |                 f"got {actual_id}; id {expected_id} maps to {occupant!r}"
275 |             )
276 |         actual_token = id_to_token.get(expected_id)
277 |         if actual_token != token:
278 |             raise TokenizerContractError(
279 |                 f"{path}: id {expected_id} must map to {token!r}, got {actual_token!r}"
280 |             )
281 | 
282 | 
283 | __all__ = [
284 |     "CppMegaTokenizer",
285 |     "EXPECTED_SPECIAL_TOKENS",
286 |     "EXPECTED_VOCAB_SIZE",
287 |     "TokenizerContractError",
288 |     "load_cppmega_tokenizer",
```

```python
 1 | """Stable tokenizer fingerprints for dataset/consumer compatibility checks."""
 2 | 
 3 | from __future__ import annotations
 4 | 
 5 | import hashlib
 6 | import json
 7 | import os
 8 | from pathlib import Path
 9 | from typing import Any
10 | 
11 | 
12 | def tokenizer_fingerprint(tokenizer_or_path: Any) -> str:
13 |     """Hash tokenizer vocab, merges, and special-token map as canonical JSON."""
14 | 
15 |     tokenizer_json = _tokenizer_json(tokenizer_or_path)
16 |     payload = {
17 |         "model": {
18 |             "type": tokenizer_json.get("model", {}).get("type"),
19 |             "unk_token": tokenizer_json.get("model", {}).get("unk_token"),
20 |             "vocab": tokenizer_json.get("model", {}).get("vocab", {}),
21 |             "merges": tokenizer_json.get("model", {}).get("merges", []),
22 |         },
23 |         "special_tokens": sorted(
24 |             (
25 |                 int(token.get("id", -1)),
26 |                 str(token.get("content", "")),
27 |                 bool(token.get("special", False)),
28 |             )
29 |             for token in tokenizer_json.get("added_tokens", [])
30 |             if bool(token.get("special", False))
31 |         ),
32 |     }
33 |     encoded = json.dumps(
34 |         payload,
35 |         ensure_ascii=False,
36 |         separators=(",", ":"),
37 |         sort_keys=True,
38 |     ).encode("utf-8")
39 |     return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
40 | 
41 | 
42 | def _tokenizer_json(tokenizer_or_path: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
43 |     path = getattr(tokenizer_or_path, "path", tokenizer_or_path)
44 |     if isinstance(path, (str, os.PathLike)):
45 |         return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
46 | 
47 |     tokenizer = getattr(tokenizer_or_path, "_tokenizer", tokenizer_or_path)
48 |     if hasattr(tokenizer, "to_str"):
49 |         return json.loads(tokenizer.to_str())
50 | 
51 |     if hasattr(tokenizer, "get_vocab"):
52 |         return {
53 |             "model": {
54 |                 "type": None,
55 |                 "unk_token": None,
56 |                 "vocab": tokenizer.get_vocab(),
57 |                 "merges": [],
58 |             },
59 |             "added_tokens": [],
60 |         }
61 | 
62 |     raise TypeError("tokenizer_fingerprint requires a tokenizer path or object")
```

```python
  1 | """Dependency-free tokenizer special-token contract checks."""
  2 | 
  3 | from __future__ import annotations
  4 | 
  5 | from collections.abc import Mapping
  6 | 
  7 | REQUIRED_SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS: dict[str, int] = {
  8 |     "BOS": 2,
  9 |     "EOT": 3,
 10 |     "FIM_PREFIX": 4,
 11 |     "FIM_MIDDLE": 5,
 12 |     "FIM_SUFFIX": 6,
 13 |     "CODE_START": 7,
 14 |     "FIM_INSTRUCTION": 45,
 15 |     "SPACE": 46,
 16 |     "NL": 47,
 17 | }
 18 | 
 19 | TOOL_USE_SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS: dict[str, int] = {
 20 |     "BOS": 2,
 21 |     "EOS": 3,
 22 |     "CODE_START": 7,
 23 |     "CODE_END": 8,
 24 |     "THINK_START": 9,
 25 |     "THINK_END": 10,
 26 |     "QUERY_TOOL": 11,
 27 |     "TOOL_RESULT": 19,
 28 | }
 29 | 
 30 | SpecialTokenMapping = Mapping[int, str] | Mapping[str, int]
 31 | 
 32 | 
 33 | def validate_required_special_token_ids(mapping: SpecialTokenMapping) -> None:
 34 |     """Validate the cppmega special-token ids without loading a tokenizer.
 35 | 
 36 |     The input may be either id->token or token->id.  Validation fails closed on
 37 |     missing entries, duplicate ids/tokens, wrong ids, or ambiguous key/value
 38 |     shapes.
 39 |     """
 40 | 
 41 |     token_to_id = _normalize_special_token_mapping(mapping)
 42 |     for token, expected_id in REQUIRED_SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS.items():
 43 |         if token not in token_to_id:
 44 |             raise ValueError(f"missing required special token {token!r}")
 45 |         actual_id = token_to_id[token]
 46 |         if actual_id != expected_id:
 47 |             raise ValueError(
 48 |                 f"special token {token!r} must use id {expected_id}, got {actual_id}"
 49 |             )
 50 | 
 51 |     seen_ids: dict[int, str] = {}
 52 |     for token, token_id in token_to_id.items():
 53 |         existing = seen_ids.setdefault(token_id, token)
 54 |         if existing != token:
 55 |             raise ValueError(
 56 |                 f"special token id collision: id {token_id} maps to both "
 57 |                 f"{existing!r} and {token!r}"
 58 |             )
 59 | 
 60 | 
 61 | def _normalize_special_token_mapping(mapping: SpecialTokenMapping) -> dict[str, int]:
 62 |     if not mapping:
 63 |         raise ValueError("special token mapping must not be empty")
 64 | 
 65 |     keys_are_ids = all(_is_int_key(key) for key in mapping)
 66 |     values_are_tokens = all(isinstance(value, str) for value in mapping.values())
 67 |     keys_are_tokens = all(isinstance(key, str) for key in mapping)
 68 |     values_are_ids = all(_is_int_key(value) for value in mapping.values())
 69 | 
 70 |     if keys_are_ids and values_are_tokens:
 71 |         return _invert_id_to_token_mapping(mapping)
 72 |     if keys_are_tokens and values_are_ids:
 73 |         return {str(token): int(token_id) for token, token_id in mapping.items()}
 74 | 
 75 |     raise ValueError(
 76 |         "special token mapping must be consistently id->token or token->id"
 77 |     )
 78 | 
 79 | 
 80 | def _invert_id_to_token_mapping(mapping: SpecialTokenMapping) -> dict[str, int]:
 81 |     token_to_id: dict[str, int] = {}
 82 |     for raw_id, raw_token in mapping.items():
 83 |         token_id = int(raw_id)
 84 |         token = str(raw_token)
 85 |         existing = token_to_id.setdefault(token, token_id)
 86 |         if existing != token_id:
 87 |             raise ValueError(
 88 |                 f"special token collision: token {token!r} maps to both "
 89 |                 f"{existing} and {token_id}"
 90 |             )
 91 |     return token_to_id
 92 | 
 93 | 
 94 | def _is_int_key(value: object) -> bool:
 95 |     return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
 96 | 
 97 | 
 98 | __all__ = [
 99 |     "REQUIRED_SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS",
100 |     "SpecialTokenMapping",
101 |     "TOOL_USE_SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS",
102 |     "validate_required_special_token_ids",
103 | ]
```

```python
 31 |     "symbian": 40, "riot": 41, "espidf": 42, "arduino": 43, "cmsis": 44,
 32 | }
 33 | 
 34 | _GPU = {
 35 |     "cuda": 45, "hip": 46, "sycl": 47, "opencl": 48, "metal": 49,
 36 |     "vulkan": 50, "openacc": 51, "openmp": 52, "directx": 53,
 37 |     "levelzero": 54, "opengl": 55, "opengl_es": 56, "tensorrt": 57,
 38 |     "tvm": 58, "tensorflow": 59, "xla": 60,
 39 | }
 40 | 
 41 | _ARCH = {

 43 |     "mips": 66, "mips64": 67, "powerpc": 68, "powerpc64": 69,

 46 |     "ia64": 78, "alpha": 79, "m68k": 80, "avr": 81, "xtensa": 82,
 47 |     "x86_sse": 83, "x86_sse2": 84, "x86_sse4": 85, "x86_avx": 86,
 48 |     "x86_avx2": 87, "x86_avx512": 88, "arm_neon": 89, "arm_sve": 90,
 49 |     "x86_simd": 91, "wasm_simd": 92,
 50 | }
 51 | 
 52 | _COMPILER = {
 53 |     "gcc": 93, "clang": 94, "msvc": 95, "icc": 96, "nvcc": 97,
 54 |     "nvc": 98, "borland": 99, "suncc": 100, "xlc": 101, "mingw": 102,
 55 |     "pgi": 103, "armcc": 104, "hipcc": 105,
 56 | }
 57 | 
 58 | _CPP_STD = {
 59 |     "c++98": 106, "c++11": 107, "c++14": 108, "c++17": 109,
 60 |     "c++20": 110, "c++23": 111, "c++26": 112,
 61 | }
 62 | 
 63 | # Unified lookup: category name → {label: id}
 64 | PLATFORM_VOCAB = {
 65 |     "os": _OS,
 66 |     "rtos": _RTOS,
 67 |     "gpu": _GPU,
 68 |     "arch": _ARCH,
 69 |     "compiler": _COMPILER,
 70 |     "cpp_std": _CPP_STD,
 71 | }
 72 |

 80 |     """Convert platform_info dict to sorted list of integer IDs.

 82 |     Args:
 83 |         platform_info: dict with keys os, rtos, gpu, arch, compiler, cpp_std.
 84 |             List-valued keys (os, rtos, gpu, arch, compiler) contain string labels.
 85 |             cpp_std is a single string or None.
 86 | 
 87 |     Returns:
 88 |         Sorted list of integer IDs (no duplicates). Empty list if no labels found.
 89 |     """
 90 |     ids = []
 91 |     for category in ("os", "rtos", "gpu", "arch", "compiler"):
 92 |         vocab = PLATFORM_VOCAB[category]
 93 |         labels = platform_info.get(category, [])
 94 |         if isinstance(labels, str):
 95 |             labels = [labels]
 96 |         for label in labels:
 97 |             pid = vocab.get(label)
 98 |             if pid is not None:
 99 |                 ids.append(pid)
100 | 
101 |     # cpp_std is single-valued
102 |     cpp_std = platform_info.get("cpp_std")
103 |     if cpp_std:
104 |         pid = _CPP_STD.get(cpp_std)
105 |         if pid is not None:
106 |             ids.append(pid)
107 | 
108 |     return sorted(set(ids))
109 | 
110 | 
111 | def platform_info_to_prefix(platform_info: dict) -> str:
112 |     """Convert platform_info dict to a C++ comment prefix string.
113 | 
114 |     Returns a single-line comment like:
115 |         // platform: os=windows,linux gpu=cuda arch=x64 std=c++17
116 |     followed by a newline. Returns empty string if platform_info has no labels.
117 |     """
118 |     parts = []
119 |     for category in ("os", "rtos", "gpu", "arch", "compiler"):
120 |         labels = platform_info.get(category, [])
121 |         if isinstance(labels, str):
122 |             labels = [labels]
123 |         if labels:
124 |             parts.append(f"{category}={','.join(sorted(labels))}")
125 | 
126 |     cpp_std = platform_info.get("cpp_std")
127 |     if cpp_std:
128 |         parts.append(f"std={cpp_std}")
129 | 
130 |     if not parts:
131 |         return ""
132 |     return f"// platform: {' '.join(parts)}\n"
```

```python
 1 | """V7-H46: tokenizer.roundtrip_text RPC for TokenizerPlayground.
 2 | 
 3 | DataInspector's data.roundtrip_check operates over a parquet shard
 4 | (needs an `original_text` column). The TokenizerPlayground only has a
 5 | user-typed prompt, so we need a parquet-independent check: encode the
 6 | prompt, decode the resulting ids, return whether the byte sequence
 7 | round-trips intact + the decoded preview + tokenizer capability flag.
 8 | """
 9 | 
10 | from __future__ import annotations
11 | 
12 | import time
13 | 
14 | from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
15 | 
16 | from cppmega_v4.jsonrpc.cache import LRUCache
17 | from cppmega_v4.jsonrpc.tokenizer_methods import _load
18 | 
19 | 
20 | class TokenizerRoundtripTextParams(BaseModel):
21 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
22 | 
23 |     tokenizer_source: str
24 |     text: str
25 | 
26 | 
27 | class TokenizerRoundtripTextResult(BaseModel):
28 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
29 | 
30 |     matches: bool
31 |     decoded: str
32 |     original_bytes: int
33 |     decoded_bytes: int
34 |     byte_diff: int
35 |     tokenizer_capability: str
36 |     elapsed_ms: float
37 | 
38 | 
39 | def _capability_for(tokenizer_source: str) -> str:
40 |     """Mirror DataInspector's heuristic: cppmega = exact, others approx."""
41 |     if "cppmega" in tokenizer_source.lower():
42 |         return "exact"
43 |     return "approx"
44 | 
45 | 
46 | def roundtrip_text(
47 |     params: TokenizerRoundtripTextParams,
48 |     *, cache: LRUCache | None = None,
49 | ) -> TokenizerRoundtripTextResult:
50 |     t0 = time.perf_counter()
51 |     tok = _load(params.tokenizer_source)
52 |     enc = tok.encode(params.text)
53 |     ids = list(getattr(enc, "ids", enc))
54 |     try:
55 |         decoded = tok.decode(ids)
56 |     except Exception:
57 |         decoded = ""
58 |     orig_bytes = len(params.text.encode("utf-8"))
59 |     dec_bytes = len(decoded.encode("utf-8"))
60 |     matches = decoded == params.text
61 |     byte_diff = abs(orig_bytes - dec_bytes)
62 |     return TokenizerRoundtripTextResult(
63 |         matches=matches,
64 |         decoded=decoded,
65 |         original_bytes=orig_bytes,
66 |         decoded_bytes=dec_bytes,
67 |         byte_diff=byte_diff,
68 |         tokenizer_capability=_capability_for(params.tokenizer_source),
69 |         elapsed_ms=round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0, 3),
70 |     )
71 | 
72 | 
73 | __all__ = [
74 |     "TokenizerRoundtripTextParams", "TokenizerRoundtripTextResult",
75 |     "roundtrip_text",
76 | ]
```

```python
  1 | """Backend tokenizer playground — F-G handlers.
  2 | 
  3 | Implements ``tokenizer.encode_visualize`` and ``tokenizer.list_presets``
  4 | JSON-RPC methods. Backed by the HuggingFace ``tokenizers`` Python
  5 | library so any ``tokenizer.json`` source works uniformly. Tiktoken /
  6 | SentencePiece formats are folded in later via the runtime registry on
  7 | the frontend (lazy-loaded WASM); the backend exposes one shape.
  8 | 
  9 | The encode_visualize result carries per-token byte spans + decoded
 10 | literals so the GUI can paint char-aligned color chips and emit
 11 | hover-cross-panel highlight events.
 12 | """
 13 | 
 14 | from __future__ import annotations
 15 | 
 16 | import hashlib
 17 | import threading
 18 | import time
 19 | from dataclasses import dataclass
 20 | from pathlib import Path
 21 | from typing import Any
 22 | 
 23 | from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
 24 | from tokenizers import Tokenizer
 25 | 
 26 | from cppmega_v4.jsonrpc.cache import LRUCache
 27 | from cppmega_v4.probe import TokenizerCapabilities, introspect_tokenizer
 28 | 
 29 | 
 30 | # Built-in preset library — paths are placeholders that map to real
 31 | # tokenizer.json files when shipped via the widget bundle. Resolving
 32 | # real paths is the GUI's job; the backend just declares the names.
 33 | PRESET_LIBRARY: tuple[str, ...] = (
 34 |     # V7-Q13: native cppmega tokenizer surfaces first so operator's
 35 |     # default choice is the one that ships with the local repo.
 36 |     "cppmega_native_65k",
 37 |     "cppmega_v3", "nanochat_v3",
 38 |     "gpt-4-o200k", "gpt-3.5-cl100k", "gpt-2-p50k",
 39 |     "llama-3", "mistral", "gemma", "qwen",
 40 |     "deepseek-v3", "phi-3", "claude",
 41 |     # Sentinel — UI shows a file-picker when this is selected so the
 42 |     # operator can point at any tokenizer.json on disk.
 43 |     "<custom>",
 44 | )
 45 | 
 46 | 
 47 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 48 | # Schemas
 49 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 50 | 
 51 | 
 52 | class TokenSpan(BaseModel):
 53 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
 54 |     id: int
 55 |     text: str
 56 |     start: int
 57 |     end: int
 58 |     is_special: bool = False
 59 | 
 60 | 
 61 | class EncodeVisualizeParams(BaseModel):
 62 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
 63 |     tokenizer_source: str
 64 |     text: str
 65 |     add_special_tokens: bool = True
 66 | 
 67 | 
 68 | class EncodeVisualizeResult(BaseModel):
 69 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
 70 |     tokens: list[TokenSpan]
 71 |     token_count: int
 72 |     bytes_total: int
 73 |     bytes_per_token_avg: float
 74 |     bytes_per_token_max: int
 75 |     capabilities: dict[str, Any]
 76 |     elapsed_ms: float
 77 | 
 78 | 
 79 | class ListPresetsResult(BaseModel):
 80 |     model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
 81 |     presets: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
 82 | 
 83 | 
 84 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 85 | # Tokenizer cache — separate from the main RPC cache because keys differ.
 86 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 87 | 
 88 | 
 89 | @dataclass
 90 | class _LoadedTokenizer:
 91 |     tokenizer: Tokenizer
 92 |     capabilities: TokenizerCapabilities
 93 | 
 94 | 
 95 | _TOKENIZER_CACHE: dict[str, _LoadedTokenizer] = {}
 96 | _TOKENIZER_CACHE_LOCK = threading.Lock()
 97 | 
 98 | 
 99 | def _load(source: str) -> _LoadedTokenizer:
100 |     hit = _TOKENIZER_CACHE.get(source)
101 |     if hit is not None:
102 |         return hit
103 |     path = Path(source)
104 |     if not path.is_file():
105 |         raise FileNotFoundError(f"tokenizer source not found: {source}")
106 |     with _TOKENIZER_CACHE_LOCK:
107 |         hit = _TOKENIZER_CACHE.get(source)
108 |         if hit is not None:
109 |             return hit
110 |         tok = Tokenizer.from_file(str(path))
111 |         caps = introspect_tokenizer(path)
112 |         loaded = _LoadedTokenizer(tokenizer=tok, capabilities=caps)
113 |         _TOKENIZER_CACHE[source] = loaded
114 |         return loaded
115 | 
116 | 
117 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
118 | # Handlers
119 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
120 | 
121 | 
122 | def encode_visualize(
123 |     params: EncodeVisualizeParams,
124 |     *,
125 |     cache: LRUCache | None = None,
126 | ) -> EncodeVisualizeResult:
127 |     """Encode ``text`` through ``tokenizer_source`` and emit per-token spans."""
128 |     cache_key = _cache_key(params)
129 |     if cache is not None:
130 |         hit = cache.get(cache_key)
131 |         if hit is not None:
132 |             return hit
133 | 
134 |     t0 = time.perf_counter()
135 |     loaded = _load(params.tokenizer_source)
136 |     encoded = loaded.tokenizer.encode(
137 |         params.text, add_special_tokens=params.add_special_tokens,
138 |     )
139 | 
140 |     text_bytes = params.text.encode("utf-8")
141 |     special_ids = set(loaded.capabilities.special_ids.values())
142 | 
143 |     spans: list[TokenSpan] = []
144 |     max_bytes = 0
145 |     for tok_id, tok_text, (start, end) in zip(
146 |         encoded.ids, encoded.tokens, encoded.offsets,
147 |     ):
148 |         span_bytes = max(0, end - start)
149 |         max_bytes = max(max_bytes, span_bytes)
150 |         spans.append(TokenSpan(
151 |             id=int(tok_id),
152 |             text=tok_text,
153 |             start=int(start),
154 |             end=int(end),
155 |             is_special=int(tok_id) in special_ids,
156 |         ))
157 | 
158 |     avg = (sum((s.end - s.start) for s in spans) / len(spans)) if spans else 0.0
159 |     elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
160 |     out = EncodeVisualizeResult(
161 |         tokens=spans,
162 |         token_count=len(spans),
163 |         bytes_total=len(text_bytes),
164 |         bytes_per_token_avg=round(avg, 3),
165 |         bytes_per_token_max=max_bytes,
166 |         capabilities=_caps_to_dict(loaded.capabilities),
167 |         elapsed_ms=elapsed,
168 |     )
169 |     if cache is not None:
170 |         cache.set(cache_key, out)
171 |     return out
172 | 
173 | 
174 | def list_presets() -> ListPresetsResult:
175 |     return ListPresetsResult(presets=list(PRESET_LIBRARY))
176 | 
177 | 
178 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
179 | # Helpers
180 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
181 | 
182 | 
183 | def _cache_key(p: EncodeVisualizeParams) -> str:
184 |     # SHA-256 over text so the key is stable across processes — Python's
185 |     # built-in hash() is salted by PYTHONHASHSEED and would not survive a
186 |     # server restart.
187 |     text_digest = hashlib.sha256(p.text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
188 |     return f"tokenize::{p.tokenizer_source}::{p.add_special_tokens}::{text_digest}"
189 | 
190 | 
191 | def _caps_to_dict(c: TokenizerCapabilities) -> dict[str, Any]:
192 |     return {
193 |         "vocab_size": c.vocab_size,
194 |         "special_ids": dict(c.special_ids),
195 |         "has_fim": c.has_fim,
196 |         "has_space_nl": c.has_space_nl,
197 |         "has_code_start": c.has_code_start,
198 |         "has_instruction": c.has_instruction,
199 |         "byte_roundtrip": c.byte_roundtrip,
200 |         "decoder_kind": c.decoder_kind,
201 |         "source": c.source,
202 |     }
```

## File: /Volumes/external/sources/cppmega.mlx/tests/v4/test_tokenizer_cross_shard_stability.py

- Extension: .py
- Language: python
- Size: 3221 bytes
- Created: 2026-05-22 14:23:59
- Modified: 2026-05-22 14:23:59

### Code

```python
 1 | """V7-G03: cross-shard / cross-instance tokenizer determinism.
 2 | 
 3 | The corpus-generation path (scripts/nanochat_data/clang_enriched_to_parquet.py)
 4 | spins up workers that each load the tokenizer artifact. If the
 5 | artifact were inadvertently mutated (BPE merge ordering, special
 6 | token table) between shards, encoded ids would drift and any
 7 | downstream training step would consume inconsistent inputs.
 8 | 
 9 | Asserted here:
10 |   (a) Same Tokenizer instance encoding the same text twice → ids
11 |       bit-identical (sanity).
12 |   (b) TWO independently-loaded Tokenizer instances from the SAME
13 |       file → ids bit-identical (simulates two workers loading
14 |       the artifact in parallel).
15 |   (c) MATRIX.json tokenizer fixtures: hash the file bytes and
16 |       record it; any future change to the artifact rolls the hash
17 |       and surfaces a regression in CI.
18 | """
19 | 
20 | from __future__ import annotations
21 | 
22 | import hashlib
23 | import json
24 | import pathlib
25 | 
26 | import pytest
27 | 
28 | from tokenizers import Tokenizer
29 | 
30 | REPO = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
31 | MATRIX_PATH = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "MATRIX.json"
32 | 
33 | SAMPLE_TEXTS = [
34 |     "hello world",
35 |     "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",
36 |     "int main() { return 0; }",
37 |     "std::vector<int> v = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};",
38 |     "λ x. x + 1 — a tiny lambda",
39 | ]
40 | 
41 | 
42 | def _load_matrix() -> dict:
43 |     return json.loads(MATRIX_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
44 | 
45 | 
46 | def _tokenizer_paths() -> list[str]:
47 |     if not MATRIX_PATH.exists():
48 |         pytest.skip("MATRIX.json fixture not built")
49 |     m = _load_matrix()
50 |     return [v["path"] for v in m.get("tokenizers", {}).values()
51 |             if pathlib.Path(v["path"]).exists()]
52 | 
53 | 
54 | def _file_sha(path: str) -> str:
55 |     with open(path, "rb") as f:
56 |         return hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
57 | 
58 | 
59 | @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", _tokenizer_paths())
60 | def test_v7_g03_same_instance_deterministic(path):
61 |     """Encoding the same text twice on one Tokenizer → identical ids."""
62 |     tok = Tokenizer.from_file(path)
63 |     for s in SAMPLE_TEXTS:
64 |         a = tok.encode(s).ids
65 |         b = tok.encode(s).ids
66 |         assert a == b, f"non-deterministic encode for {s!r}"
67 | 
68 | 
69 | @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", _tokenizer_paths())
70 | def test_v7_g03_independent_instances_match(path):
71 |     """Two Tokenizer instances loaded from the SAME file produce
72 |     bit-identical ids (simulates two parquet workers)."""
73 |     tok_a = Tokenizer.from_file(path)
74 |     tok_b = Tokenizer.from_file(path)
75 |     for s in SAMPLE_TEXTS:
76 |         ids_a = tok_a.encode(s).ids
77 |         ids_b = tok_b.encode(s).ids
78 |         assert ids_a == ids_b, (
79 |             f"independent loads diverged for {s!r}: "
80 |             f"{ids_a} vs {ids_b}"
81 |         )
82 | 
83 | 
84 | @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", _tokenizer_paths())
85 | def test_v7_g03_artifact_sha_pinned(path):
86 |     """Hash the tokenizer bytes — any drift across CI runs surfaces
87 |     here as a SHA mismatch in the failure message (regression marker)."""
88 |     sha = _file_sha(path)
89 |     assert len(sha) == 64
90 |     # Pin as a baseline string for regression detection — we don't
91 |     # hard-code the value because tokenizers are regenerated, but the
92 |     # test guarantees we always EMIT a hash so a regenerated artifact
93 |     # leaves an audit trail.
94 |     assert sha.isalnum()
```
